candidates.decision_relevance: Would resolve the repeated mismatch between short-horizon reversals and 24–72-hour returns, and permit lead-lag analysis of price, flow, funding, open interest, breadth, and ETH/BTC persistence.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily director outputs from 2026-09-09 through 2026-09-12 repeatedly report unavailable or incorrectly spanned 1-hour/4-hour/12-hour windows and cross-horizon disagreement.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped canonical hourly BTC, ETH, and ETH/BTC sequences with actual elapsed spans
candidates.missing_history_problem: Observed windows are sometimes shorter than their nominal labels or have zero span, preventing reliable sequencing, persistence, and reversal analysis.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would materially distinguish narrow ETH rotation from broad participation and test whether abrupt proxy-breadth changes represented persistent market-wide participation or membership noise.
candidates.evidence_reference: Multiple daily and weekly reviews identify point-in-time top-100 breadth with changing membership hashes as insufficient to confirm broad rotation or distribution.
candidates.metric_name: Stable-universe cross-sectional breadth and relative-performance history
candidates.missing_history_problem: The available breadth proxy is not membership-stable or canonical, so changes from roughly 0.17 to 0.76 advance ratios cannot be interpreted as persistence or regime evidence.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would test whether settled ETF demand was persistent, concentrated, and transmitted into price and participation, rather than relying on isolated session totals.
candidates.evidence_reference: Reviews repeatedly note that ETF evidence consists of only one or a few settled sessions and cannot establish a flow trend or price-response relationship.
candidates.metric_name: Asset-level settled ETF net-flow history with timestamps and price/breadth alignment
candidates.missing_history_problem: Single-session positive or negative totals cannot distinguish durable demand from concentration, offsetting flows, or flow without market transmission.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would resolve whether reported deleveraging and liquidation episodes were dominated by long forced selling, short covering, or both, and whether they preceded recovery or continued weakness.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews explicitly state that liquidation composition, open-interest normalization, and post-deleveraging recovery evidence are absent; daily reviews call aggregates lower bounds with unverified completeness.
candidates.metric_name: Venue-complete liquidation events joined to position-side, open-interest, funding, and subsequent price response
candidates.missing_history_problem: Lower-bound aggregate liquidation totals are directionally ambiguous and cannot distinguish a leverage reset from continuing distribution.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would provide contemporaneous macro context for assessing whether crypto weakness or rotation occurred alongside broader liquidity and risk-asset conditions.
candidates.evidence_reference: Several daily reviews report missing or stale macro context because the FRED owner is disabled.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped macro/liquidity observations available at each analysis cutoff
candidates.missing_history_problem: The analyses cannot determine whether the observed crypto price, breadth, and flow changes were idiosyncratic or part of a broader macro risk move.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would permit ex-ante audit and matured scoring of the recurring forecast candidates, including broad-range containment, target precision, hindsight leakage, and confidence calibration.
candidates.evidence_reference: All weekly reviews note that candidate specifications, freeze times, evidence cutoffs, confidence values, and matured outcomes are absent despite repeated candidate generation.
candidates.metric_name: Frozen forecast-candidate registry with issue timestamps, evidence cutoffs, exact bounds/targets, confidence, and realized outcomes
candidates.missing_history_problem: Candidate count alone cannot establish forecast skill, calibration, sequence integrity, false-positive rates, or opportunity cost.
